findings.summary: Parlatore-Hegseth attorney relationship dates from CVA departure (Jan 2016), not just the 2017 Monterey assault — Parlatore quoted as Hegseth's CVA severance/NDA attorney in CBS News Nov 2024.
findings.detail: Per CBS News reporting (Nov 2024) on Hegseth's CVA NDA and severance, 'Attorney Timothy Parlatore described it as a "standard severance package"' and stated 'They make EVERYONE who leaves CVA sign an NDA. It was standard for all employees.' This places Parlatore in Hegseth's attorney role at the time of the January 2016 CVA departure — predating the previously documented 2017 Monterey assault matter (finding 10807) by 18+ months. The Parlatore-Hegseth attorney-client relationship therefore spans at least 9 years (Jan 2016 - present) rather than 8 years (Oct 2017 - present). This is material because: (a) it strengthens the personal-loyalty / longstanding-counsel basis for Parlatore's 2025 Pentagon placement (commission, press-credentialing policy, Signalgate/Yemen chat participation, JAG overhaul); (b) it shows Parlatore was Hegseth's defense attorney during the period when the Feb 2015 whistleblower report was in CVA management's hands; (c) Parlatore's framing of the CVA NDA as 'standard for all employees' is a public-record statement defending the Koch network's NDA-on-departure practice — a structural feature of the CVA pipeline that limits whistleblower exit. Parlatore is also handling the leak investigations that led to Caldwell/Selnick/Carroll firings in April 2025 (finding 10772).

findings.summary: Parlatore-Epoch Times prior media relationship documented: Tim Parlatore appeared multiple times on the Shawn Ryan Show, with Episode #49 'The Fight for Free Speech Against a Foreign Government' (released Feb 23, 2023) explicitly framing the Dallas Alexander/Canadian podcast censorship case as 'foreign government' interference with American free speech. Episode coverage was carried by The Epoch Times, Breitbart, and The Blaze. Episode #114 'The Weaponization of 3 Letter Agencies' (May 30, 2024) — three days before Guan indictment — extended the same anti-government overreach frame. Parlatore is a regular Fox News / CNN / MSNBC commentator (per his firm bio). The pre-existing media relationship and ideological alignment ('free speech against a foreign government' / 'weaponization of agencies') maps cleanly onto the Selective Prosecution defense theory Parlatore advances for Hung. This is an ideological-fit pattern, not a paid attorney-client relationship per se, but supports the inference that Epoch Times pre-existing trust in Parlatore's brand drove the August 2025 retainer decision.

Parlatore was a participant in second Hegseth Signal chat about Yemen strikes (with Jennifer Hegseth, Phil Hegseth) — Pentagon IG SignalGate report (Dec 3-4 2025) found Hegseth risked endangering troops
findings.detail: Per multiple outlets covering the Pentagon IG SignalGate findings released Dec 3-4 2025: in addition to texting attack plans to the VP and senior admin officials in the first Signal chat, SecDef Pete Hegseth relayed the same details via a second chat that included Tim Parlatore, Hegseth's wife Jennifer, and his brother Phil Hegseth. Parlatore publicly pushed back against the IG findings claiming the report 'exonerates' Hegseth and that the troop-endangerment finding was 'untethered from the rest of the report.' This follows October 2025 Politico (Lippman/Gerstein) reporting that OSI investigators were probing whether Parlatore — a personal attorney serving as a top DOD adviser — attended meetings beyond his clearance level where classified information was discussed, and his role investigating the leaks. The convergence of (a) Politico/WaPo conflict reporting, (b) Pentagon IG findings, and (c) Indyke Jan 23 2026 House Oversight subpoena bracket the same window in which 4 senior PLG partners departed.

findings.detail: Wave 6 update: (1) Direct ETAI 990 evidence is insufficient — 2024 990 not yet filed; 2023 disclosed only $1.2M prof fundraising fees with no legal-defense line. (2) Only disclosed officer overlap with indicted parties is Guan (the CFO defendant). (3) ETAI grant tree shows $54M+ to Universal Communications Network (NTD) and $11M to Epoch Public Foundation — either subsidiary could be a routing vehicle for legal expenses. (4) Friends of Falun Gong (EIN 13-4145670) sponsors Human Rights Law Foundation — but FoFG/HRLF activity is PRC persecution litigation, not US criminal defense. (5) Parlatore-Shawn Ryan Show ecosystem and Trump-Epoch alignment suggest a politically-aligned funder (501c4 or PAC) is also possible. (6) Hung is 29 Vietnamese extradited — has zero plausible personal means. Hypothesis remains likely (not confirmed); requires 2024 ETAI 990, PACER pull of Doc 104/110 if either characterizes funding source, or future ETAI Schedule O indemnification disclosure.
